```{r}

set.seed(42)

# ============================================================
# pILC RNA-seq: focused chromatin and epigenetic pathway analysis
#
# Analyses
#   1. DESeq2 VST from raw HTSeq counts
#   2. Epigenetic pathway extraction from MSigDB C5 + custom GMT
#   3. Curated SWI/SNF, PRC1/2, HDAC/HAT, histone and DNA methylation sets
#   4. Sample-level ssGSEA pathway scores and cluster comparisons
#   5. Cluster-versus-rest DESeq2 ranking and fgseaMultilevel
#   6. Pathway and leading-edge heatmaps
#
# Important interpretation
#   The three clusters were derived from these expression data. Results
#   characterize the clusters and do not constitute independent validation.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  required_packages <- c(
    "DESeq2", "data.table", "fgsea", "GSVA", "ggplot2",
    "ComplexHeatmap", "circlize", "grid"
  )

  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
      "\nInstall Bioconductor packages with:\n",
      "if (!requireNamespace('BiocManager', quietly=TRUE)) install.packages('BiocManager')\n",
      "BiocManager::install(c(",
      paste(sprintf("'%s'", missing_packages), collapse = ", "),
      "))"
    )
  }

  library(DESeq2)
  library(data.table)
  library(fgsea)
  library(GSVA)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

graphics.off()

# ============================================================
# Input and output paths
# ============================================================

count_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/VST_data/htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv"

cluster_gct_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/GenePattern_NMFConsensus/vst_transformed_data.consensus.k.3.gct"

c5_gmt_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/c5.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"

custom_gmt_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/custom_gene_sets.gmt"

out_root <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Epigenetic_Pathway_Analysis"

run_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
out_dir <- file.path(
  out_root,
  paste0("pILC_Epigenetic_Pathway_Analysis_", run_date)
)
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")

dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_files <- c(
  count_file = count_file,
  cluster_gct_file = cluster_gct_file,
  c5_gmt_file = c5_gmt_file,
  custom_gmt_file = custom_gmt_file
)

missing_inputs <- names(input_files)[!file.exists(input_files)]
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required input file(s) not found:\n",
    paste0(missing_inputs, ": ", input_files[missing_inputs], collapse = "\n")
  )
}

fwrite(
  data.table(Input = names(input_files), Path = unname(input_files)),
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("input_file_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

clean_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x
}

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
}

zscore_rows <- function(mat, cap = 2.5) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z[z > cap] <- cap
  z[z < -cap] <- -cap
  z
}

prefix_pathways <- function(pathways, prefix) {
  if (!length(pathways)) return(list())
  pathways <- lapply(pathways, function(g) unique(clean_gene(g)))
  pathways <- lapply(pathways, function(g) g[g != ""])
  names(pathways) <- paste0(prefix, "__", make.unique(names(pathways)))
  pathways
}

write_matrix_tsv <- function(mat, row_name, file) {
  dt <- as.data.table(mat, keep.rownames = row_name)
  fwrite(dt, file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")
}

# ============================================================
# Read NMF cluster membership
# ============================================================

cluster_dt <- fread(cluster_gct_file, skip = 2, data.table = TRUE)

required_cluster_cols <- c("Name", "Description")
if (!all(required_cluster_cols %in% names(cluster_dt))) {
  stop("Cluster GCT must contain Name and Description columns.")
}

membership_cols <- grep("^membership", names(cluster_dt), value = TRUE)
if (length(membership_cols) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected exactly one membership column in cluster GCT; found: ",
    paste(membership_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cluster_dt <- cluster_dt[
  ,
  .(
    Sample_original = Name,
    Sample = clean_sample(Name),
    Cluster_number = as.integer(get(membership_cols[1]))
  )
]

if (anyNA(cluster_dt$Cluster_number)) {
  stop("Non-numeric or missing cluster memberships detected.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(cluster_dt$Sample)) {
  stop("Duplicate samples after removing GenePattern _S suffixes.")
}

cluster_dt[, Cluster := factor(
  paste0("Cluster ", Cluster_number),
  levels = c("Cluster 1", "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3")
)]

if (anyNA(cluster_dt$Cluster)) {
  stop("Cluster membership must be 1, 2 or 3.")
}

cluster_colors <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77",
  "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02",
  "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3"
)

setorder(cluster_dt, Cluster_number)

fwrite(
  cluster_dt,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("pILC_cluster_metadata_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

message("Cluster sizes:")
print(cluster_dt[, .N, by = Cluster])

# ============================================================
# Read and validate raw HTSeq counts
# ============================================================

count_dt <- fread(count_file, data.table = TRUE)
if (!("Gene" %in% names(count_dt))) {
  stop("Count file must contain a column named Gene.")
}

count_dt[, Gene := clean_gene(Gene)]
count_dt <- count_dt[Gene != "" & !grepl("^__", Gene)]

sample_cols <- setdiff(names(count_dt), "Gene")

missing_samples <- setdiff(cluster_dt$Sample, sample_cols)
extra_samples <- setdiff(sample_cols, cluster_dt$Sample)

if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Cluster samples missing from the count matrix: ",
    paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (length(extra_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Count-matrix samples without cluster assignments: ",
    paste(extra_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Aggregate duplicate symbols if upper-casing or annotation produced duplicates.
count_dt <- count_dt[
  ,
  lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = Gene,
  .SDcols = sample_cols
]

count_dt <- count_dt[, c("Gene", cluster_dt$Sample), with = FALSE]
count_matrix <- as.matrix(count_dt[, -"Gene"])
rownames(count_matrix) <- count_dt$Gene
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"

if (anyNA(count_matrix)) stop("Missing count values detected.")
if (any(count_matrix < 0)) stop("Negative count values detected.")
if (any(count_matrix != round(count_matrix))) {
  stop("The HTSeq input contains non-integer values; raw counts are required.")
}
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"

metadata <- data.frame(
  Sample = cluster_dt$Sample,
  Cluster = cluster_dt$Cluster,
  row.names = cluster_dt$Sample,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# DESeq2 normalization and VST
# ============================================================

dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ Cluster
)

# Retain genes with at least 10 reads in at least 3 tumors.
keep_gene <- rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 10) >= 3

filter_audit <- data.table(
  Gene = rownames(dds0),
  Total_count = rowSums(counts(dds0)),
  Samples_with_count_ge_10 = rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 10),
  Retained = keep_gene
)

fwrite(
  filter_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("gene_filter_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

dds <- dds0[keep_gene, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "Wald", parallel = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)

vst_object <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vst_matrix <- assay(vst_object)

normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)

write_matrix_tsv(
  normalized_counts,
  "Gene",
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("DESeq2_normalized_counts_", run_date, ".tsv"))
)

write_matrix_tsv(
  vst_matrix,
  "Gene",
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("DESeq2_VST_expression_", run_date, ".tsv"))
)

# ============================================================
# Read pathway collections
# ============================================================

c5_all <- prefix_pathways(fgsea::gmtPathways(c5_gmt_file), "C5")
custom_all <- prefix_pathways(fgsea::gmtPathways(custom_gmt_file), "CUSTOM")

# Terms intentionally focus on chromatin and epigenetic biology.
epigenetic_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    "CHROMATIN", "HISTONE", "NUCLEOSOME", "EPIGENETIC",
    "DNA_METHYL", "DNA_DEMETHYL", "METHYLTRANSFERASE", "DEMETHYLASE",
    "ACETYLTRANSFERASE", "DEACETYLASE", "HISTONE_ACETYL",
    "SWI.*SNF", "BAF_COMPLEX", "PBAF", "POLYCOMB", "PRC1", "PRC2",
    "HDAC", "HAT_COMPLEX", "EZH", "KMT", "KDM",
    "COVALENT_CHROMATIN", "CHROMOSOME_ORGANIZATION"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

c5_epi <- c5_all[grepl(epigenetic_pattern, names(c5_all), ignore.case = TRUE)]
custom_epi <- custom_all[
  grepl(epigenetic_pattern, names(custom_all), ignore.case = TRUE)
]

# Curated core programs supplement ontology terms and permit direct inspection
# of biologically important epigenetic complexes.
curated_sets <- list(
  CURATED__SWI_SNF_BAF_CORE = c(
    "ARID1A", "ARID1B", "ARID2", "SMARCA2", "SMARCA4", "SMARCB1",
    "SMARCC1", "SMARCC2", "SMARCD1", "SMARCD2", "SMARCD3", "SMARCE1",
    "ACTL6A", "ACTL6B", "DPF1", "DPF2", "DPF3", "BCL7A", "BCL7B",
    "BCL7C", "BRD7", "BRD9", "PBRM1"
  ),
  CURATED__PRC2_CORE = c(
    "EZH1", "EZH2", "EED", "SUZ12", "RBBP4", "RBBP7", "JARID2",
    "AEBP2", "MTF2", "PHF1", "PHF19", "EPOP"
  ),
  CURATED__PRC1_CORE = c(
    "RING1", "RNF2", "BMI1", "PCGF1", "PCGF2", "PCGF3", "PCGF4",
    "PCGF5", "PCGF6", "CBX2", "CBX4", "CBX6", "CBX7", "CBX8",
    "PHC1", "PHC2", "PHC3"
  ),
  CURATED__HDAC_PROGRAM = c(
    "HDAC1", "HDAC2", "HDAC3", "HDAC4", "HDAC5", "HDAC6", "HDAC7",
    "HDAC8", "HDAC9", "HDAC10", "HDAC11", "SIRT1", "SIRT2", "SIRT3",
    "SIRT4", "SIRT5", "SIRT6", "SIRT7", "NCOR1", "NCOR2", "SIN3A",
    "SIN3B", "MTA1", "MTA2", "MTA3", "CHD3", "CHD4"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_ACETYLTRANSFERASE_HAT_PROGRAM = c(
    "CREBBP", "EP300", "KAT2A", "KAT2B", "KAT5", "KAT6A", "KAT6B",
    "KAT7", "KAT8", "ELP3", "NCOA1", "NCOA2", "NCOA3", "CLOCK"
  ),
  CURATED__DNA_METHYLATION_WRITERS_READERS = c(
    "DNMT1", "DNMT3A", "DNMT3B", "DNMT3L", "UHRF1", "UHRF2",
    "MECP2", "MBD1", "MBD2", "MBD3", "MBD4", "ZBTB33", "ZBTB38",
    "ZBTB4"
  ),
  CURATED__DNA_DEMETHYLATION_PROGRAM = c(
    "TET1", "TET2", "TET3", "TDG", "GADD45A", "GADD45B", "GADD45G",
    "AICDA", "APOBEC1"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_LYSINE_METHYLTRANSFERASES = c(
    "KMT2A", "KMT2B", "KMT2C", "KMT2D", "KMT2E", "KMT5A", "KMT5B",
    "KMT5C", "SETD1A", "SETD1B", "SETD2", "SETD3", "SETD5", "SETD6",
    "SETD7", "SETD8", "SETDB1", "SETDB2", "EHMT1", "EHMT2", "SUV39H1",
    "SUV39H2", "EZH1", "EZH2", "DOT1L", "NSD1", "NSD2", "NSD3"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_LYSINE_DEMETHYLASES = c(
    "KDM1A", "KDM1B", "KDM2A", "KDM2B", "KDM3A", "KDM3B", "KDM4A",
    "KDM4B", "KDM4C", "KDM4D", "KDM4E", "KDM5A", "KDM5B", "KDM5C",
    "KDM5D", "KDM6A", "KDM6B", "KDM7A", "KDM8", "JMJD6", "PHF2",
    "PHF8"
  ),
  CURATED__CHROMATIN_REMODELING_EXPANDED = c(
    "ARID1A", "ARID1B", "ARID2", "SMARCA2", "SMARCA4", "SMARCB1",
    "SMARCC1", "SMARCC2", "PBRM1", "CHD1", "CHD2", "CHD3", "CHD4",
    "CHD5", "CHD6", "CHD7", "CHD8", "CHD9", "ATRX", "DAXX", "SRCAP",
    "EP400", "INO80", "INO80B", "INO80C", "INO80D", "INO80E", "HELLS"
  )
)
curated_sets <- lapply(curated_sets, clean_gene)

all_epi_pathways <- c(c5_epi, custom_epi, curated_sets)

# Ensure unique pathway names and retain expressed genes only.
names(all_epi_pathways) <- make.unique(names(all_epi_pathways))
expressed_genes <- rownames(vst_matrix)

pathway_audit <- rbindlist(lapply(names(all_epi_pathways), function(nm) {
  original_genes <- unique(clean_gene(all_epi_pathways[[nm]]))
  matched_genes <- intersect(original_genes, expressed_genes)
  source <- sub("__.*$", "", nm)
  data.table(
    Pathway = nm,
    Source = source,
    Original_gene_count = length(original_genes),
    Expressed_gene_count = length(matched_genes),
    Expressed_genes = paste(sort(matched_genes), collapse = ";")
  )
}))

fwrite(
  pathway_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_pathway_gene_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE
)

# Minimum 3 expressed genes permits core protein complexes to be scored.
# Interpret very small gene sets cautiously.
epi_pathways <- lapply(all_epi_pathways, intersect, y = expressed_genes)
epi_pathways <- lapply(epi_pathways, unique)
epi_pathways <- epi_pathways[lengths(epi_pathways) >= 3 & lengths(epi_pathways) <= 500]

if (length(epi_pathways) == 0) {
  stop("No epigenetic pathways retained after expression and size filtering.")
}

message("Epigenetic pathways retained: ", length(epi_pathways))

fwrite(
  data.table(
    Pathway = names(epi_pathways),
    Expressed_gene_count = lengths(epi_pathways)
  ),
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("retained_epigenetic_pathways_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ============================================================
# Sample-level ssGSEA scores
# ============================================================

message("Running sample-level ssGSEA...")

gsva_exports <- getNamespaceExports("GSVA")

if ("ssgseaParam" %in% gsva_exports) {
  ssgsea_param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(
    exprData = vst_matrix,
    geneSets = epi_pathways,
    minSize = 3,
    maxSize = 500,
    normalize = TRUE
  )
  ssgsea_scores <- GSVA::gsva(ssgsea_param, verbose = FALSE)
} else {
  # Compatibility with older GSVA releases.
  ssgsea_scores <- GSVA::gsva(
    expr = vst_matrix,
    gset.idx.list = epi_pathways,
    method = "ssgsea",
    kcdf = "Gaussian",
    min.sz = 3,
    max.sz = 500,
    abs.ranking = TRUE,
    ssgsea.norm = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

ssgsea_scores <- as.matrix(ssgsea_scores)
ssgsea_scores <- ssgsea_scores[, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE]

write_matrix_tsv(
  ssgsea_scores,
  "Pathway",
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_scores_", run_date, ".tsv"))
)

# ============================================================
# Global and pairwise pathway-score comparisons
# ============================================================

score_long <- melt(
  as.data.table(ssgsea_scores, keep.rownames = "Pathway"),
  id.vars = "Pathway",
  variable.name = "Sample",
  value.name = "Score"
)

score_long <- merge(
  score_long,
  cluster_dt[, .(Sample, Cluster)],
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
score_long[, Cluster := factor(Cluster, levels = levels(cluster_dt$Cluster))]

global_tests <- score_long[
  ,
  {
    kw <- kruskal.test(Score ~ Cluster)
    list(
      Kruskal_Wallis_statistic = unname(kw$statistic),
      P_value = kw$p.value,
      Cluster1_median = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 1"], na.rm = TRUE),
      Cluster2_median = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 2"], na.rm = TRUE),
      Cluster3_median = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 3"], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  },
  by = Pathway
]
global_tests[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]
setorder(global_tests, FDR, P_value)

fwrite(
  global_tests,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_global_cluster_tests_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

pair_defs <- list(
  Cluster2_vs_Cluster1 = c("Cluster 2", "Cluster 1"),
  Cluster3_vs_Cluster1 = c("Cluster 3", "Cluster 1"),
  Cluster3_vs_Cluster2 = c("Cluster 3", "Cluster 2")
)

pairwise_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(names(pair_defs), function(comparison) {
  pair <- pair_defs[[comparison]]

  ans <- score_long[
    Cluster %in% pair,
    {
      x <- Score[Cluster == pair[1]]
      y <- Score[Cluster == pair[2]]
      wt <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
      list(
        Cluster_A = pair[1],
        Cluster_B = pair[2],
        Median_A = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median_B = median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median_difference_A_minus_B = median(x, na.rm = TRUE) - median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
        Wilcoxon_statistic = unname(wt$statistic),
        P_value = wt$p.value
      )
    },
    by = Pathway
  ]

  ans[, Comparison := comparison]
  ans[, FDR_within_comparison := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]
  ans
}), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

setcolorder(
  pairwise_tests,
  c(
    "Comparison", "Pathway", "Cluster_A", "Cluster_B", "Median_A",
    "Median_B", "Median_difference_A_minus_B", "Wilcoxon_statistic",
    "P_value", "FDR_within_comparison"
  )
)
setorder(pairwise_tests, Comparison, FDR_within_comparison, P_value)

fwrite(
  pairwise_tests,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_pairwise_cluster_tests_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# ssGSEA heatmap
# ============================================================

n_heatmap_pathways <- min(40L, nrow(global_tests))
heatmap_pathways <- head(global_tests$Pathway, n_heatmap_pathways)
heatmap_score_matrix <- zscore_rows(
  ssgsea_scores[heatmap_pathways, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE]
)

column_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cluster = cluster_dt$Cluster,
  col = list(Cluster = cluster_colors),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  simple_anno_size = unit(4, "mm")
)

score_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

score_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_score_matrix,
  name = "Pathway Z-score",
  col = score_col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_split = cluster_dt$Cluster,
  column_order = cluster_dt$Sample,
  top_annotation = column_annotation,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  row_title = "Epigenetic pathways",
  column_title = "pILC tumors grouped by NMF RNA cluster",
  border = TRUE
)

pdf(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_cluster_heatmap_", run_date, ".pdf")),
  width = 15,
  height = max(10, 0.22 * n_heatmap_pathways + 4)
)
draw(score_heatmap, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

png(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_cluster_heatmap_", run_date, ".png")),
  width = 4500,
  height = max(3000, 80 * n_heatmap_pathways + 1000),
  res = 300
)
draw(score_heatmap, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

# ============================================================
# Top pathway boxplots
# ============================================================

top_box_pathways <- head(global_tests$Pathway, min(12L, nrow(global_tests)))
box_dt <- score_long[Pathway %in% top_box_pathways]
box_dt[, Pathway := factor(Pathway, levels = rev(top_box_pathways))]

box_plot <- ggplot(box_dt, aes(x = Cluster, y = Score, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Pathway, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Epigenetic pathway scores across pILC RNA clusters",
    subtitle = "Top pathways ranked by global Kruskal-Wallis FDR",
    x = NULL,
    y = "ssGSEA enrichment score"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_top_pathway_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf")),
  box_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)
ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_top_pathway_boxplots_", run_date, ".png")),
  box_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)

# ============================================================
# Cluster-versus-rest DESeq2 and ranked GSEA
# ============================================================

gsea_results <- list()
deseq_cluster_results <- list()

for (target_cluster in levels(metadata$Cluster)) {
  message("Running cluster-versus-rest DESeq2 and GSEA: ", target_cluster)

  dds_target <- dds
  target_group <- ifelse(
    colData(dds_target)$Cluster == target_cluster,
    "Target",
    "Rest"
  )
  colData(dds_target)$Target_vs_rest <- factor(
    target_group,
    levels = c("Rest", "Target")
  )
  design(dds_target) <- ~ Target_vs_rest

  # Refit the model for the binary target-versus-rest comparison.
  dds_target <- DESeq(dds_target, test = "Wald", parallel = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)

  res <- results(
    dds_target,
    contrast = c("Target_vs_rest", "Target", "Rest"),
    alpha = 0.05,
    independentFiltering = TRUE
  )

  res_dt <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(res), keep.rownames = "Gene")
  res_dt[, Target_cluster := target_cluster]
  res_dt[, Direction := fifelse(
    !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0,
    paste0("Higher_in_", target_cluster),
    fifelse(
      !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0,
      "Higher_in_Rest",
      "Not_significant"
    )
  )]
  setorder(res_dt, padj, pvalue, na.last = TRUE)
  deseq_cluster_results[[target_cluster]] <- res_dt

  cluster_safe <- safe_name(target_cluster)
  fwrite(
    res_dt,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0("DESeq2_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".tsv")
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  ranks <- res_dt[!is.na(stat), stat]
  names(ranks) <- res_dt[!is.na(stat), Gene]
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

  set.seed(42)
  fg <- fgseaMultilevel(
    pathways = epi_pathways,
    stats = ranks,
    minSize = 3,
    maxSize = 500,
    eps = 0,
    scoreType = "std",
    nproc = 1
  )

  fg <- as.data.table(fg)
  fg[, Target_cluster := target_cluster]
  fg[, Direction := fifelse(
    NES > 0,
    paste0("Enriched_in_", target_cluster),
    "Enriched_in_Rest"
  )]
  fg[, Abs_NES_for_sorting := abs(NES)]
  setorder(fg, padj, pval, -Abs_NES_for_sorting, na.last = TRUE)
  fg[, Abs_NES_for_sorting := NULL]
  gsea_results[[target_cluster]] <- fg

  fg_export <- copy(fg)
  fg_export[, leadingEdge := vapply(
    leadingEdge,
    function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"),
    character(1)
  )]

  fwrite(
    fg_export,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0("fgsea_epigenetic_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".tsv")
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  plot_fg <- fg[!is.na(padj)]
  if (nrow(plot_fg) > 0) {
    significant_fg <- plot_fg[padj < 0.05]
    if (nrow(significant_fg) >= 5) {
      plot_fg <- head(significant_fg, 20)
    } else {
      plot_fg <- head(plot_fg, 20)
    }

    plot_fg[, pathway := factor(pathway, levels = rev(pathway))]
    plot_fg[, minus_log10_fdr := -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))]

    gsea_dot <- ggplot(
      plot_fg,
      aes(x = NES, y = pathway, size = minus_log10_fdr, color = NES)
    ) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(target_cluster, " versus the other RNA clusters"),
        subtitle = "Ranked GSEA of chromatin and epigenetic pathways",
        x = "Normalized enrichment score",
        y = NULL,
        size = "-log10 FDR",
        color = "NES"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )

    ggsave(
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("fgsea_epigenetic_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".pdf")
      ),
      gsea_dot,
      width = 11,
      height = 8
    )
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("fgsea_epigenetic_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".png")
      ),
      gsea_dot,
      width = 11,
      height = 8,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

all_deseq_cluster_results <- rbindlist(
  deseq_cluster_results,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)
fwrite(
  all_deseq_cluster_results,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("DESeq2_all_clusters_vs_rest_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

all_gsea <- rbindlist(gsea_results, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
all_gsea_export <- copy(all_gsea)
all_gsea_export[, leadingEdge := vapply(
  leadingEdge,
  function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"),
  character(1)
)]

fwrite(
  all_gsea_export,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("fgsea_epigenetic_all_clusters_vs_rest_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Leading-edge gene table and heatmap
# ============================================================

sig_gsea <- all_gsea[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05]
if (nrow(sig_gsea) == 0) {
  message("No GSEA pathways reached FDR <0.05; using the top 5 per cluster for leading-edge review.")
  sig_gsea <- all_gsea[order(padj, pval), head(.SD, 5), by = Target_cluster]
}

leading_edge_long <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(sig_gsea)), function(i) {
  genes <- sig_gsea$leadingEdge[[i]]
  if (!length(genes)) return(NULL)
  data.table(
    Target_cluster = sig_gsea$Target_cluster[i],
    Pathway = sig_gsea$pathway[i],
    NES = sig_gsea$NES[i],
    FDR = sig_gsea$padj[i],
    Gene = genes
  )
}), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(leading_edge_long) > 0) {
  fwrite(
    leading_edge_long,
    file.path(table_dir, paste0("fgsea_leading_edge_genes_", run_date, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  leading_rank <- leading_edge_long[
    ,
    .(
      Pathway_count = uniqueN(Pathway),
      Cluster_count = uniqueN(Target_cluster),
      Minimum_FDR = min(FDR, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = Gene
  ]
  setorder(leading_rank, -Cluster_count, -Pathway_count, Minimum_FDR)

  leading_genes <- head(leading_rank$Gene, 75)
  leading_genes <- intersect(leading_genes, rownames(vst_matrix))

  if (length(leading_genes) >= 2) {
    leading_mat <- zscore_rows(
      vst_matrix[leading_genes, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    )

    leading_heatmap <- Heatmap(
      leading_mat,
      name = "Expression Z-score",
      col = score_col_fun,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_columns = FALSE,
      column_split = cluster_dt$Cluster,
      column_order = cluster_dt$Sample,
      top_annotation = column_annotation,
      show_column_names = TRUE,
      column_names_rot = 90,
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
      row_title = "Epigenetic pathway leading-edge genes",
      column_title = "DESeq2 VST expression",
      border = TRUE
    )

    pdf(
      file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_leading_edge_gene_heatmap_", run_date, ".pdf")),
      width = 15,
      height = max(10, 0.18 * length(leading_genes) + 4)
    )
    draw(leading_heatmap, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
    dev.off()

    png(
      file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_leading_edge_gene_heatmap_", run_date, ".png")),
      width = 4500,
      height = max(3000, 65 * length(leading_genes) + 1000),
      res = 300
    )
    draw(leading_heatmap, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
    dev.off()
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Compact analysis summary
# ============================================================

summary_dt <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Samples",
    "Cluster_1_samples",
    "Cluster_2_samples",
    "Cluster_3_samples",
    "Genes_before_filtering",
    "Genes_after_filtering",
    "C5_epigenetic_pathways_selected",
    "Custom_epigenetic_pathways_selected",
    "Curated_pathways_defined",
    "Total_pathways_scored",
    "ssGSEA_pathways_global_FDR_lt_0.05",
    "GSEA_rows_FDR_lt_0.05"
  ),
  Value = c(
    ncol(count_matrix),
    sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 1"),
    sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 2"),
    sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 3"),
    nrow(dds0),
    nrow(dds),
    length(c5_epi),
    length(custom_epi),
    length(curated_sets),
    length(epi_pathways),
    sum(global_tests$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(all_gsea$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

fwrite(
  summary_dt,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_pathway_analysis_summary_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

writeLines(
  c(
    paste0("pILC chromatin and epigenetic pathway analysis: ", run_date),
    "Seed: 42",
    paste0("Raw counts: ", count_file),
    paste0("NMF clusters: ", cluster_gct_file),
    paste0("C5 GMT: ", c5_gmt_file),
    paste0("Custom GMT: ", custom_gmt_file),
    "DESeq2 prefilter: count >=10 in at least 3 samples",
    "Sample-level scoring: ssGSEA on DESeq2 VST expression",
    "Global score comparison: Kruskal-Wallis with BH FDR",
    "Pairwise score comparison: Wilcoxon rank-sum with BH FDR within each contrast",
    "Ranked enrichment: fgseaMultilevel using DESeq2 Wald statistics",
    "GSEA contrasts: each cluster versus the other two clusters",
    "Small curated gene sets with >=3 expressed genes were retained; interpret small sets cautiously.",
    "The RNA clusters were derived from the same expression data. These analyses characterize the clusters and are not independent validation.",
    "RNA pathway enrichment supports transcriptional programs consistent with epigenetic dysregulation but does not directly prove an epigenetic mechanism."
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("README_pILC_Epigenetic_Pathway_Analysis_", run_date, ".txt"))
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("sessionInfo_", run_date, ".txt"))
)

message("Analysis complete.")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir)
print(summary_dt)

graphics.off()
```
